## Research internships

I take a small number of postgraduate research interns each year. Internships are remote, unpaid and run for at least three months. Please read this page before writing to me.

### Research area

My current work is on ethical AI and AI governance: the regulatory, organisational and behavioural side of AI systems, studied with empirical and computational methods. I am not recruiting for statistical machine learning or predictive modelling at present: the work involves no model training, feature engineering or architecture tuning.

### What you need to bring

I can guide the research but you should already be comfortable with:

- web scraping and API-based data collection at scale, and structuring messy data;
- Python, including running open-weight large language models locally (Ollama, Hugging Face, vLLM or similar);
- turning computational output into business, policy or ethical insight.

Students of MBA (technology or analytics), M.Tech. (data science or AI) and M.Sc. (data science) programmes usually fit best.

### The work

Research is broader than coding. Expect literature review, data cleaning, validation of results and some academic writing.

### Terms

- Remote, with a minimum commitment of three months.
- Work runs on weekly milestones.
- Code and data pipelines must be documented and reproducible. Fabricated data, unverified AI-generated output or plagiarism are not allowed.
- Data, code and drafts from the project are confidential and stay with the project. You may list the project title and a short summary on your CV.
- Unpaid: I have no grant funding for stipends at present. If that changes, I will tell you before the internship starts.

### What you get

Regular reviews and feedback on your work, experience on a live research project aimed at journal publication, and a letter from me describing your contribution on completion. A substantial contribution to a manuscript earns co-authorship; smaller contributions are acknowledged.

### How to apply

Email [aritra.pan@mse.ac.in](mailto:aritra.pan@mse.ac.in) with:

- your CV;
- a link to code you have written (GitHub or a sample showing scraping or LLM work);
- the hours per week you can commit and your earliest start date.

Applications without a code sample are not considered.

## Collaboration

For research or consultancy collaboration, write to the same address.
